player-identity.description: Scopes karaoke and vocal-pitch practice to the active player's voice role.

audio-input.description: Registers the karaoke microphone as a managed input source while it is listening. Capture stays in-plugin; no audio is stored or transmitted.

host_requirements._note: Extension key, not yet ratified by the plugin spec. Hosts MUST ignore manifest keys they do not recognise, so this is additive and inert today.

backend.reason: Pinned to a core commit, not a release, because no distinct core version represents it yet. Commit 0dcc913 is the first to ship lib/dlc_paths.py, the shared DLC containment helper this plugin resolves songs through. Older hosts stay supported: routes.py falls back to lib/safepath.py safe_join, which is what the host's own _resolve_dlc_path was before that commit, so preparation and /playback work from minHost upward.

player_identity.reason: Scoping karaoke to the active player needs the host's player-identity capability (window.feedBack.playerContexts), which arrived after 0.3.0-alpha.1. Without it the plugin still prepares lyrics and pitch, renders the highway, and scores the microphone; only the per-player voice role is skipped.

peer_requirements._note: Extension key, not yet ratified by the plugin spec. Hosts MUST ignore manifest keys they do not recognise, so this is additive and inert today.

note_detect.reason: Below 1.15.2 Note Detect cannot hand off microphone ownership, so Lyrics Karaoke withholds mic feedback rather than scoring in parallel.
